title: Canadian Electrical Code Part I Safety Standard for Electrical Installations
mandatory_status: Adopted by provincial and territorial authorities with local amendments
summary: Model Canadian installation code for electrical work and equipment in buildings, structures, and premises.
notes: Track province and territory adoption separately.

title: National Electrical Code
mandatory_status: Adopted by states and local authorities with amendments
summary: U.S. benchmark code for safe electrical design, installation, and inspection.
notes: Track state and local adoption separately.

title: National Electrical Safety Code
mandatory_status: Adopted or referenced by utilities and authorities where applicable
summary: Safety code for electric supply stations, overhead lines, underground lines, and related work rules.
notes: Often relevant to utility-owned facilities and lines.

title: Reliability Standards
mandatory_status: Enforceable after approval or adoption by applicable regulatory authority
summary: Reliability requirements for planning and operating the North American bulk power system.
notes: Families include BAL, CIP, COM, EOP, FAC, MOD, PRC, TOP, TPL, VAR, and others.

title: Interconnection and Interoperability of Distributed Energy Resources with Associated Electric Power Systems Interfaces
mandatory_status: Adopted or referenced by regulators, utilities, and interconnection rules
summary: Technical requirements for DER interconnection and interoperability with electric power systems.
notes: Amendment IEEE 1547a-2020 should be tracked as related edition metadata.

title: Workplace Electrical Safety
mandatory_status: Referenced with occupational health and safety duties and employer programs
summary: Canadian workplace electrical safety standard harmonized in part with NFPA 70E and Canadian electrical code context.
notes: Track relationship to CSA Z460, CSA M421, and CE Code Parts I, II, and III.

title: Standard for Electrical Safety in the Workplace
mandatory_status: Used for employer electrical safety programs and OSHA-aligned practices
summary: Workplace electrical safety standard covering safety-related work practices, maintenance, and special equipment.
notes: Do not copy article text; store metadata and applicability notes only.

title: Inverters Converters Controllers and Interconnection System Equipment for Use With Distributed Energy Resources
mandatory_status: Used for product safety certification and grid-interactive DER equipment evaluation
summary: Product standard for DER inverters, converters, controllers, and interconnection system equipment.
